title: centrosema plumieri
intro: Centrosema plumieri, commonly known as the sensitive plant, is a type of leguminous vine native to tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to reduce inflammation and ease digestive issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Centrosema plumieri include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Centrosema plumieri are responsible for its various medicinal applications, including wound healing, fever reduction, and treatment of gastrointestinal disorders.
